prompt: Under Texas Transportation Code §552.003, when must a driver yield the right-of-way to a pedestrian?

options.text: Only when the pedestrian is crossing in a marked crosswalk with police escort
Exclusively during daytime hours between sunrise and standard evening sunset
Only when the pedestrian is using an audible walking cane or guide animal
Whenever a pedestrian is in a crosswalk on the half of the road you drive on
